title: Segfaults when loading meshes on task threads
body:
### Tested versions

current master @ 19bb18716

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (19bb18716) - macOS Sequoia (15.3.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Max (Apple9) - Apple M4 Max (16 threads)

### Issue description

Note: this only seems to affect forward_plus and headless, I don't get this behavior on gl_compatibility

Loading meshes on task threads and then subsequently freeing them causes segfaults and/or infinite loops.

The observed behavior is either:
- an infinite loop as it keeps trying to free materials that are already freed in [MaterialStorage::material_set_shader](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/19bb18716ef08b811fec330cba4d35fbdb027bcc/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/material_storage.cpp#L2202)
- a segfault when calling either:
   -  [MaterialStorage::shader_free](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/19bb18716ef08b811fec330cba4d35fbdb027bcc/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/material_storage.cpp#L1946) on an already freed material
   -  [MaterialStorage::material_set_shader](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/19bb18716ef08b811fec330cba4d35fbdb027bcc/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/material_storage.cpp#L2227) when setting the owner (possibly with a freed material??)

It is apparent to me that it is a race condition, as it doesn't happen every time and it depends on how many meshes are loaded at once.

It doesn't matter where you free the loaded meshes; if you free them on the task threads themselves, or you later free them on the main thread (after the group task is finished), you will eventually get one of the above observed behaviors. Loading them on the main thread performs without incident.

I've been able to have it happen pretty consistently using the attached MRP.

### Steps to reproduce

1) run the MRP
2) observe infinite loop and/or segfault when freeing the meshes

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[multithread-mesh-crash-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20237169/multithread-mesh-crash-mrp.zip)
